notes.title: Shred it up in RoboSkate's newly released Skatepark!
notes.content:
I've just released RoboSkate's second content update, which introduces the Skatepark - a brand new mini-level, featuring an open design and many ramps and rails. This new map's openly designed ramp area means you can mess around with RoboSkate and (try to) do rad tricks without fear of falling, I hope you all enjoy it!

You'll notice grafitti tags in the skatepark - most of these are the usernames of the most active members in my Discord community, which you can join [url=https://discord.gg/kCRrxx3]here[/url] to stay up to date on RoboSkate and whatever else I'm doing!

Lastly, I'd like to kindly ask for those that haven't already to leave a review for RoboSkate - it would really help me out, and I'd love to read what you think of my game :) - Shoobap

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38671743/86465526751fa6a155e4d2874ad60b23e854e720.png[/img]

Other changes:
- Added an achievement for the Skatepark mini-level.
- Decreased overall volume of the game.
- Lighting tweaks for previous mini-levels.
- Fixed a bug which caused RoboSkate's wheel to clip through the deck.
- Fixed abrupt stopping of music in mini-levels.
